droid-monkey attacked this Android app with a real-world fault and it failed. Fix the root cause.

## What happened
Attack `process_death` (process_death): Fill the screen's form, let Android kill the app in the background, then come back to it.
Steps: [{"fill": true}, {"fault": "kill_in_background"}, {"fault": "relaunch"}, {"settle": 6}]
Result: lost_state: 6 of 6 filled fields changed or emptied
Fields lost (before -> after): {'field_name': ['Ravi Kumar', ''], 'field_email': ['ravi@example.com', ''], 'field_phone': ['9876543210', ''], 'field_address': ['12 MG Road', ''], 'field_city': ['Bengaluru', ''], 'field_pincode': ['560001', '']}

## Diagnosis
Root cause: Not diagnosed (naive baseline run).
Fix approach: 
Evidence: -

## Files to change
Not diagnosed: find the root cause and the files to change yourself.

## Regression test
Add one regression test that fails before the fix and passes after it.

## Rules
- Fix the root cause in the files above with the idiomatic Android approach. Keep the change small and focused.
- Add exactly one regression test file under app/src/test (JVM unit test, preferred) or app/src/androidTest
  (instrumented), using only test libraries the project already has (see app/build.gradle.kts). It must fail on
  the old code and pass on the fixed code.
- Do not change build files or add dependencies. Do not touch unrelated code. Do not commit.
- When done, reply with one short paragraph: what you changed and the test class name.

40	/** Screens are addressed by a small route string so the back stack survives recreation. */
41	sealed interface Route {
42	    data object Shop : Route
43	    data class Detail(val productId: Int) : Route
44	    data class Checkout(val productId: Int) : Route
45	}
46	
47	private fun Route.encode(): String = when (this) {
48	    Route.Shop -> "shop"
49	    is Route.Detail -> "detail:$productId"
50	    is Route.Checkout -> "checkout:$productId"
51	}
52	
53	private fun decodeRoute(raw: String): Route = when {
54	    raw.startsWith("detail:") -> Route.Detail(raw.removePrefix("detail:").toInt())
55	    raw.startsWith("checkout:") -> Route.Checkout(raw.removePrefix("checkout:").toInt())
56	    else -> Route.Shop
57	}
58	
59	@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class, ExperimentalComposeUiApi::class)
60	@Composable
61	fun MonkeyMartApp() {
62	    var rawRoute by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(Route.Shop.encode()) }
63	    val route = decodeRoute(rawRoute)
64	    fun go(to: Route) { rawRoute = to.encode() }
65	
66	    BackHandler(enabled = route != Route.Shop) {
67	        go(if (route is Route.Checkout) Route.Detail(route.productId) else Route.Shop)
68	    }
69	
70	    Scaffold(
71	        modifier = Modifier
72	            .fillMaxSize()
73	            .semantics { testTagsAsResourceId = true },
74	        topBar = { TopAppBar(title = { Text("MonkeyMart") }) },
75	    ) { padding ->
76	        val content = Modifier.padding(padding)
77	        when (route) {
78	            Route.Shop -> ShopScreen(onProductClick = { go(Route.Detail(it)) }, modifier = content)
79	            is Route.Detail -> DetailScreen(route.productId, onBuyNow = { go(Route.Checkout(it)) }, modifier = content)
80	            is Route.Checkout -> CheckoutScreen(route.productId, modifier = content)
81	        }
82	    }
83	}

package com.shubhasai.monkeymart

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutViewModel
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class CheckoutFormProcessDeathTest {
    @Test
    fun formFields_surviveProcessDeath() {
        val handle = SavedStateHandle()
        val before = CheckoutViewModel(handle)
        before.name = "Ravi Kumar"
        before.email = "ravi@example.com"
        before.phone = "9876543210"
        before.address = "12 MG Road"
        before.city = "Bengaluru"
        before.pincode = "560001"

        val restoredHandle = SavedStateHandle(handle.keys().associateWith { handle.get<Any>(it) })
        val after = CheckoutViewModel(restoredHandle)

        assertEquals("Ravi Kumar", after.name)
        assertEquals("ravi@example.com", after.email)
        assertEquals("9876543210", after.phone)
        assertEquals("12 MG Road", after.address)
        assertEquals("Bengaluru", after.city)
        assertEquals("560001", after.pincode)
    }
}

content.text:
The checkout form's six fields now survive process death. I haven't run the build or the tests, so none of this has been compiled or run.

**Root cause:** `CheckoutViewModel` kept the fields in plain `mutableStateOf`. Android destroys the ViewModel when it kills the process, so the form came back empty on relaunch.

**Fix:** In `CheckoutViewModel.kt` the ViewModel now takes a `SavedStateHandle`. It defaults to an empty one, so `viewModel()` and the existing tests still work. Each field reads its initial value from the handle and writes every change back to it.

**Regression test:** `CheckoutFormProcessDeathTest` fills the form, rebuilds the ViewModel from the saved handle's contents, and asserts all six fields are restored. It fails on the old code because the old ViewModel has no `SavedStateHandle` constructor, so it won't compile there. It should pass on the new code.
